name: elpis-editor
description: Run the installed Elpis in a VS Code editor tab, with live editor context for /ide.

elpis.useChatView.description: Use the frozen chat view instead of the Elpis terminal. When it is on, Elpis: Open opens the chat view.

elpis.followupBehavior.description: Chat view only. Queue follow-ups until the current turn completes or steer its active turn. Ctrl+Enter chooses the opposite behavior when Enter is the send shortcut.

elpis.showContextUsage.description: Chat view only. Show the runtime's last reported context-window usage in the composer.

elpis.accountSource.description: Chat view only. Use the Elpis login or the ChatGPT login saved by Codex. Elpis configuration and history stay in Elpis home. Reconnect after changing this setting.

elpis.executable.description: The elpis binary. A name is found on PATH, then in ~/.local/bin. The terminal runs it, and the chat view runs `elpis app-server`.

elpis.home.description: Optional Elpis home directory, given to elpis as ELPIS_HOME. Empty lets elpis choose its home (ELPIS_HOME, else its default), the same as in your terminal.

elpis.provider.description: Chat view only. Inference provider. Empty uses existing Elpis configuration.

elpis.model.description: Chat view only. Optional model override; empty retains the Elpis configured model.

elpis.reasoningEffort.description: Chat view only. Reasoning effort selected from the current model's runtime capabilities; empty uses the configured default.

elpis.sendShortcut.description: Chat view only. Keyboard shortcut for sending a chat message. Shift+Enter always inserts a new line.

elpis.editorAccess.description: Permit this window to give live editor buffers, selections and language providers to Elpis (the chat view tools and the terminal /ide context). Disabling immediately blocks editor tools; start a new conversation to remove previously seen facts.

scripts.package: npm run build && vsce package --no-dependencies --allow-missing-repository --out elpis-editor-$npm_package_version.vsix
scripts.test: node --test test/rpc.test.js test/provider-catalog.test.js test/approvals.test.js test/model-repair.test.js test/settings.test.js test/account-source.test.js test/approval-modes.test.js test/history-controls.test.js test/durable-close.test.js test/followups.test.js test/inline-approval.test.js test/ide-context.test.js test/smart-pruning.test.js test/startup.test.js test/webview-cdp.test.js
